title: VET TEC 2.0 — High-Tech Training
geography: United States · VA-approved providers; approved distance-learning options vary
summary: VA program supporting eligible Veterans and transitioning service members seeking approved high-tech, non-degree training, including qualifying tuition, books and supplies, and housing payments.
eligibility_to_check: Veteran with discharge other than dishonorable or active-duty member within 180 days of separation; at least 36 months active-duty service; under age 62 at VA approval; individual VA determination required.
cost_note: VA describes tuition and fees paid directly to approved providers and additional qualifying support; exact benefits and approved courses must be checked with VA.
important_to_know: Not the 2019–2024 VET TEC pilot. Earlier certificates of eligibility cannot be reused. Provider/course approval and individual eligibility remain unconfirmed here. VA reported 2,022 openings on November 10, 2026; this is a dated snapshot, not today's guaranteed capacity.
first_step: Review VA's VET TEC 2.0 eligibility, approved provider listings and online application instructions.

duplicate_review.against_existing_21: No direct VET TEC 2.0 record found in 2026-11-09 demo catalog
duplicate_review.distinct_from: Original VET TEC pilot ended 2024; retain separate version identity

notes: Included on public concept website as an actual VA source-reviewed resource following user direction. Does not indicate provider-confirmed training intake, eligibility, or referral readiness.
